blocks.text: You can create an automation rule to automatically trigger one or more playbooks when specific conditions are met. When an alert is created, the automation rule evaluates the alert against the defined conditions. If the conditions are met, the automation rule triggers the associated playbook, which performs its configured actions.

blocks.item: In the SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC or Identities.
In the left-side navigation, go to Automations > Automation Rules.
The Automation Rules page appears.
Click New Rule.
See image.
The Create New Automation Rule page appears.
On the Create New Automation Rule page:
In the Details section:
Name: Enter a name for the automation rule.
Active: Enable to activate the automation rule. By default, this setting is enabled.
Description: Enter a description for the automation rule.
See image.
In the Triggers section:
Entity Type: Select the entity type for which you want to create the automation rule.
Alert: Select to create an automation rule for an alert.
Incident: Select to create an automation rule for an incident.
User: Select to create an automation rule for a user.
Identity Finding: Select to create an automation rule for an identity finding.
Trigger: Select the event that triggers the automation rule.
Delete: Triggers the rule when an entity is deleted.
Update: Triggers the rule when an entity is updated.
Create: Triggers the rule when an entity is created.
See image.
In the Filters section:
Select the entity field for which you want to define the condition (e.g., Alert Last Seen).
Select how the condition is evaluated (e.g., Between).
Specify the value for the condition.
To add more conditions:
AND: Requires more than one condition to be met.
OR: Requires either condition to be met.
To remove a condition, click the Delete icon.
See image.
In the Playbook section:
Search: Enter the name of a playbook to find it in the Playbook Inventory.
Playbook Inventory: Select one or more playbooks to associate with the automation rule.
The selected playbooks appear on the left.
See image.
Click Save.
The automation rule is created and displayed on the Automation Rules page.
